       Abstract
As a New Yorker, I’m painfully aware of space. There is, after all, nothing more luxurious
than empty space! So when it comes to algorithms, I’m all in favor of leaving holes in my data
structures. In this talk, I’ll explore the advantages of pampering algorithms with some much
needed breathing room.
